name: West Coast Cubing Tour: Berkeley 2025
information:
Join us for the Berkeley leg of the West Coast Cubing Tour!
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzA1MDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1cb86871b0afc95dec308fd83f64deeb72eebb0c/WCCTAnto.png)
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCTBerkeley2025#43208-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Due to extremely limited venue space, spectators are discouraged from attending this competition. 

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
